a1.title: Brake Poora Dabaya, Truck RUKA NAHI! 😱 Overload | Truck ka Science #24
a1.desc:
Brake poora dabaya, phir bhi overload truck ruka hi nahi! Kyunki truck mein hadd se zyada maal bhara tha.
Jitna zyada wazan, utni zyada taakat chahiye truck ko rokne ke liye. Par brake utne hi hain, isliye rukne ki doori bahut lambi ho jaati hai. Ghat ki utraai pe brake jaldi garam hokar kamzor ho jaate hain.
Isliye truck mein utna hi maal bharo, jitna kagaz pe likha hai, aur aage wali gaadi se doori double rakho.

D1a.title: Baarish Mein Truck Paani Pe TAIRNE Laga! 😱 Aquaplaning | Truck ka Science #25
D1a.desc:
Tez baarish mein achanak steering halki ho gayi aur truck kehna nahi maan raha! Ise kehte hain aquaplaning, yaani tyre ka paani pe tairna.
Tez speed pe tyre sadak ka paani bahar nahi nikaal paata, tyre aur sadak ke beech paani ki parat aa jaati hai aur pakad khatam.
Aise mein zor se brake mat dabao, steering jhatke se mat ghumao. Race dheere chhodo, steering seedhi rakho. Baarish mein speed hamesha kam.
